NOTICE
Candidates who applied for the post of Assistant Professor cum Junior Scientist
(Contractual) advertised vide Advt. No. BAU(VC) 13/2026 & BAU(VC) 14/2026 (Backlog)
dated 19.05.2026, their application forms have been screened by Screening Committee. The
candidate whose application is Not Qualified (N.Q) for the post is mentioned below with the
reason thereof. If candidates have any queries regarding reason of disqualification, they may
contact via recruitment mail i.e, recruitmentbau50@gmail.com within seven days of issue of this
order. After the due date, University will not consider any request of the candidates. The
Scheduled date, place & time of Interview will be intimated later on by E-mail/telephonically to
the Qualified Candidates. The list of Not Qualified (N.Q) candidates is mentioned as under :-
